module: "Rolling" capture for the Optick profiler. A first call to toggle() starts a recording that keeps only the last 20 seconds; a second call stops the recording, saves the capture to <user folder>/optick/optick_rolling_<date>.opt and opens Optick if the global function launchOptick exists. A 10 s UI message confirms each step.
notes: The window duration (20 s) is set in the file (windowSeconds).
The state is determined by Engine.Profiler.isCapturing(): any Optick capture already in progress will be stopped and saved by toggle().

toggle.desc: Starts a 20 s rolling capture if no capture is in progress; otherwise stops the capture, saves it to the user's optick/ folder and launches Optick on it.
